exportConnections.decryptKeyInfo: The decryption password is the ENCRYPTION_KEY in your data/.env file. Please keep this file secure.

backup.title: Full backup
backup.importedWithCounts: Backup imported: restored {rows} data rows and {files} files. Reloading the application.
backup.description: Export connections, proxies, SSH keys, tags, Quick Commands, themes, appearance and Workspace settings, background files and custom HTML themes. Account credentials, Passkeys, audit logs and IP ban records are excluded.
backup.importDescription: Backups from this instance can be imported while signed in without a backup password. Backups from another instance require the login password used when that backup was exported. Import replaces the backed-up business data and custom theme files.
backup.backupPasswordHelp: Leave blank for a backup created by this instance. For a cross-instance restore, enter the password used when the backup was exported.
